name: Answers every part of the question
tip: Unpack every idea the question names and answer all of it, not just the part you find easiest.
description: Covers every idea the question names, including qualifiers such as complex or diverse.

name: Follows the directive verb
tip: Do what the verb asks: explain gives how and why, analyse shows how parts make meaning, assess judges.
description: Does the task the directive verb sets: explain, analyse, assess or evaluate.

name: Analyses, doesn't retell
tip: Interpret what the text means; don't recount what happens in it.
description: Interprets what the text means rather than recounting what happens in it.

name: Explains a technique's effect
tip: Name the technique precisely, then show how it shapes meaning: technique, example, effect.
description: Names techniques with accurate metalanguage and shows how each shapes meaning.

name: Uses apt evidence
tip: Quote short, precise words or visual details that prove your point.
description: Uses short, precise quotations or visual details that prove the point.

name: Links to the human experience
tip: Tie each point back to the human experience or emotion the question names.
description: Ties the analysis to the experience or emotion the question names.

name: Writes succinctly
tip: Scale your answer to the marks: a clear claim, two or three analysed techniques, no padding.
description: Writes without padding, repetition or drift, and not well past the suggested length.
